Subject: Mum's banana bread
From: Jo <jo@example.com>

Hi love, here's the banana bread you asked about!

Mum's banana bread

Serves 8

Ingredients:
- 3 ripe bananas
- 1/3 cup melted butter
- 3/4 cup sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 tsp vanilla
- 1 1/2 cups flour

Directions:
Preheat the oven to 350F and grease a loaf tin.
Mash the bananas and stir in the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla.
Fold in the flour and pour into the tin.
Bake for 55 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

Love, Mum
